confidence_notes: Guided testing directly established the six gears through a sequential stick, the standing-start clutch, the clutchless running shifts, automatic cut, and no automatic blip.
scope_notes: Single exact identity staged from one guided-verification drive.

additional_telemetry_names.basis: Base configuration of the same car. This exact string was not observed: it is derived from the car's observed high-downforce identity by removing the suffix. Lola B2K00 Ford-Cosworth was seen in all four of this class's configurations and the same derivation reproduces its observed names exactly. Controls are inherited from the driven high-downforce configuration and were not separately tested. If the derivation is wrong the identity simply never matches, which is what a driver sees today.
